title: Keep Atlas checklist tests aligned with task status
changes: Replace stale completed-task counts and positional status assumptions with checks of each task ID and its English and Italian status; allow the checklist to evolve without fixing its completed count.
validation: The generated Atlas task table matched the source checklist using scripts/menu_atlas_tasks.py --check. The targeted Linux release Atlas tests passed: 12 passed and one optional image export ignored.

The Linux Docker portable build and complete serial suite passed: 851 tests passed, 397 ignored; the menu suite passed 128 tests with one ignored. The exported archive was inspected for the runtime and for absence of ROM, save and snapshot payloads.

An earlier focused run and Docker run passed their tests but retained diagnostics because the protected test source changed during execution; the final focused run and Docker build use the final source.
limitations: This fixes test expectations and documentation only; native Windows, physical input and game runtime behavior were not newly tested. The current Linux build artifact remains in the managed validation unit for delivery.
